facts.fact: The World Bank's appraisal document of 2024-09-04 for the Chad Digital Transformation Project says a sub-component will provide last-mile connectivity access to selected public institutions, including ministries and agencies, local government offices, health facilities and education institutions, in N'Djamena, secondary cities and remote and fragile areas; no number of local government offices is given.
facts.system: Chad Digital Transformation Project, last-mile connectivity for public institutions

facts.fact: The project that is to connect selected local government offices is financed by an IDA grant of SDR 69.5 million (US$92.2 million equivalent), within a US$120 million total, per the World Bank appraisal document of 2024-09-04.
facts.system: Chad Digital Transformation Project, last-mile connectivity for public institutions

facts.fact: The implementing agency of the Chad Digital Transformation Project, which is to connect selected local government offices, is the Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Economy, as the source page for the appraisal document of 2024-09-04 states.
facts.system: Chad Digital Transformation Project, last-mile connectivity for public institutions
